clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements of manufacture, dimensions and marking for fabricated PVC tees for potable water supplies.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 2. Requirements—The   general   requirements for materials, sizes, methods of test, sampling and critieria for conformity shall conform to  IS  10124 (Part 1) :  1988.

clauses.title: Marking
clauses.text: 4. D = mean socket internal diameter at mid-point of socket length as specified in IS : 10124 (Part 1) - 1988*. L = minimum socket length in accordance with IS : 10124 (Part 1) 1988*. B = 1.45 x nominal outside diameter of the pipe + 6 mm. t = minimum wall thickness of equal tees calculated on the basis of 90 percent of the minimum wall thickness of the corresponding size and pressure class of pipe rounded off to the next higher 0.1 mm.
